spots.text: KEEPER: KEEP THE LAMP LIT. NO SHIPS HAVE COME. KEEP IT LIT.

secrets.name: The Keeper's Room
secrets.text: At the top of the stair, a round room with a narrow bed, a stove and a log kept in a careful hand. Every entry says the same thing: lamp lit, no ships.

secrets.name: The Lamp
secrets.text: Up the ladder, through the hatch, and you are standing beside the lamp itself, with the whole dark sea of books below you and the beam going round and round over it, looking for something.

meta.label: The Lighthouse
meta.blurb: The floor of this hall is a sea of books, heaped in long dark waves, and out in the middle of it a lighthouse is keeping watch. Nobody knows what for. The lamp turns anyway.
